primary_guidance.summary: Decompose problems andsurface assumptions;compare inside/outside views;use comparable historical classes;update without overreacting;express uncertainty numerically;balance calibration andresolution;review errors andsuccesses;seek constructive disagreement;practice with clear feedback.
primary_guidance.interpretation: Motivates ledger andreview workflow,not a deterministic recipefor measured probabilities orlikelihood ratios.

tournament_evidence.methods: Approximately45minute training;Year1training×group assignment;Year2changed design andelite tracking. Probabilitytraining encouraged referenceclasses/averaging andbias checks;teams shared rationales. Elite60in5teams of12 selected fromYear1performance.
tournament_evidence.scoring: Two-category sum-of-squares0–2;averaged overdays/questions. Source p.9,y1=.02 andy0=1.62. Within-question standardization addresses selected-question difficulty;this isnot a single final-cutoff ledger score.
tournament_evidence.results: Training,teaming andtracking improved calibration/resolution inthis tournament. Aggregation algorithm details andprediction-market results are reportedelsewhere,not implemented fromthis paper.
tournament_evidence.limits: Elite selection isnot randomteam assignment;question/revision/dependence/context matter. No universal intervention guarantee.
tournament_evidence.normalization_observation: Paperprose uses two-category0–2;Note1expresses binary-form decomposition. Our mathematical observation,not authorerratum. Namebinary0–1versustwicebinary0–2andscalecomponentsconsistently.

forecast_protocol.selection: Freeze latesteligible version at/before fixedquestioncutoff,strictlybefore event occurrence/knownoutcome;one event-participant score. Lateupdates remainvisiblebutunscored. No outcome-informed choice ofrevision.
forecast_protocol.time_limits: Local clocks/identities/knowledge aredeclarations;hashchain cannot prevent owner rewriting history. Independent timestamp/commitment needed forprospective integrity.
forecast_protocol.negative_event_time: For nonoccurrence, distinguish the question window end and earliest outcome-knowable time from a positive occurrence timestamp. Freeze this rule before implementation;never invent an actual occurrence time for an event that did not occur.

bayesian_conventions.likelihood: LR=P(E|H)/P(E|notH). LR mustbe finite nonnegative exact rational firstscope orderive fromexplicitvalid conditionalpair. It isanassumption unlessestimatedfromauditable independentdata.
bayesian_conventions.boundaries: L1leavesp;p0remains0withfiniteL;p1remains1withpositiveL;L0gives0onlywhendenominatorpositive;p1,L0orzero-evidence denominator rejects. No silent certainty repair.
bayesian_conventions.dependence: Unique evidenceIDs anddependencygroups;reject repeated IDs. Multiplication onlyfor conditionalLRgivenhistory ordeclared conditional independence underBOTH hypotheses;differentnews articles can repeatonesource. Declarations do notprove independence.
bayesian_conventions.certain_event: No arbitrary confidenceword-to-LR conversion;manual forecaster revisions kept distinct fromBayes formula correctness.

scoring_conventions.log_loss: Natural-log loss=-ln(p) fory1,-ln(1-p) fory0. Correctendpoint0;contradictedendpointtagpositive_infinity;undefinednoscorenullwithreason. No nonfinite JSON orsilentclipping. PinDecimalprecision/rounding before implementation.
scoring_conventions.aggregation: Eachquestion selectedonce perparticipant/cutoff;explicitlyseparate event-average,participant-average,teamaggregate anddaily/tournament scores. Missingness andhorizon differ;requirepairmatching.
scoring_conventions.calibration: Propose10leftclosedbins[k/10,(k+1)/10),lastincludes1;reportcount,meanp,outcomerate andnull empty bins. Descriptivebin estimates are not calibrationcertification;bins frozenpreoutcome.
scoring_conventions.resolution: Higherresolution isoutcomerate separation acrossprobabilitygroups;not merely extremep. Murphyidentityusesidentical forecastgroups;coarsebinsneedadditionalwithinbin terms. BinarycaseBrier=REL-RES+UNC;doubleallterms for2categoryscale.
scoring_conventions.limits: Rare-event prevalence canproduce lowloss;report prevalence,horizon/missingness,uniqueevents andgroups. Small/dependent samples do notestablish team/individualsuperiority;no automaticpvalues.
